Thanks go to a patient evening
Readers will enjoy rest areas
Pet travel notes from Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping the week smooth with friendly reminders for travelers and staff. Please keep carriers tidy, labels clear, and water bowls ready before check-in. A welfare coordinator is available to review comfort needs, and the team should answer questions with care and speed. <<FACT F004>> For everyone passing through, the best routine is simple: check documents, confirm crate fit, and speak calmly to each handler.

The latest roundup also highlights how easy it is to stay organized when pets are moving through the skyport. <<FACT F012>> That steady approach helps reduce stress for Millie, and it gives Milan Rossi and Aya Brown a clearer path through the day. Keep notices plain, updates prompt, and the lounge welcoming, so every journey starts on a reassuring note.
